title: Cube-Root Inference for the Risk-Minimizing Treatment-Initiation Window in Illness-Death Models
banked_reason: The reported honest set is not presently executable: A_M is only asserted to be a finite public constant, with no displayed value or finite procedure for computing it from the public envelopes.
proof_attempt_summary: Stage 0 derived the moving-average representation, combined gradient, exact coherent fitted-score remainder, oracle endpoint experiment, and a lower construction on the explicit dominance regime. D0.5 found that the primitive learner was not specified or proved well enough to support feasible upper inference, that the joint cross-fit conditioning was invalid, and that the reported radius was not computable. A future retry needs explicit delayed-entry estimators and concentration bounds, foldwise inference, public constants, and a broader lower family or a narrower headline.
tldr: The causal risk is the normalized natural-hazard moving average, and the observed endpoint experiment and feasible martingale-corrected criterion are explicit. The proved coherent local-remainder theorem and projected learner bounds yield feasible uniform squared-center risk of \(n^{-2/3}\), uniformly honest center-set diameter of order \(n^{-1/3}\), and a pointwise Chernoff law with estimable scale at fixed smooth interior laws. The fixed full-history pair gives matching lower bounds throughout the stated dominance regime, including its exact margin-curvature boundary. No uniform Chernoff calibration is claimed.
gap: Fixed-center window-risk inference is available, and generic discontinuous M-estimation explains cube-root limits, but neither literature controls the difference of a fitted censored illness--death score across two moving endpoints with a learned natural-hazard normalizer.
fill: The proposal isolates the exact cancellation as an explicit kill-test question, supplies a learner construction and local-process route, derives the model-specific endpoint scale, and makes a numerically fixed nonempty envelope regime plus a finite-calculus membership certificate the sole prerequisite for the complete-history minimax converse.
